name: Route Block with Healthy Stock Cover
description: Highway blocked on Mumbai-Pune corridor LANE-MUM-PUN-RD. Destination site SITE-PUN-03 has healthy stock (21 days cover). Alternative rail corridor LANE-MUM-PUN-RL adds 2 days delay.
report_text: DISRUPTION ALERT: Rockslide has blocked Mumbai-Pune Expressway along LANE-MUM-PUN-RD. Transit for incoming shipments to Pune Central Distribution Center (SITE-PUN-03) is blocked for 48-72 hours. Severity: 3.
test_purpose: Reroute chosen when healthy stock cover can absorb the minor delay without incurring costly reorders.
